draft.author: Lance Zierlein
draft.summary: NFL.com graded him 5.80, the 216th-best grade among 259 2023 draftees and 10th of 14 at QB. He went 127th overall, well ahead of where his grade ranked (216th): teams liked him more than the published grade. Testing standouts: vertical jump (81st percentile). College production: 2,896 passing yards in 2022, 11th of 14 QBs in his class with stats.

current.summary: Year 4 pro, currently with the New York Giants (practice squad). 8 career games and 1 starts over 1 completed season. Still developing: 1 AV in 2024. Strengths in 2024: sacks taken 6 (98th percentile), interceptions thrown 1 (98th percentile). Weak spots: passing yards 226 (1st percentile), passing td 1 (1st percentile). Played 8 of 17 games in 2024. Versus the typical Year-2 quarterback who played: 226 passing yards against a median of 1,765, below the norm.
